# v0.1.0 — First-pass implementation report
**Date:** 2026-11-22 · **Branch:** `develop` · **Version:** 0.1.0 (development preview, not a release)

> **Superseded in parts by the [video correction pass report](05-V0.1.0-CORRECTION-PASS-REPORT.md)** (availability registry, popout limits, window presets, Home, Quick access, news). This file was missing from Git until 2026-11-22 because a `build/` ignore rule also matched `docs/build/`.

This is the first complete, runnable PokeMMO Companion: one normal desktop app with five sections, optional independent popouts, local persistence and honest source labelling. It is meant for the user's walkthrough video and the v0.1.1 triage that follows.

## 1. Technology decision (and the feasibility spike)
**Stack:** a stdlib-only Python core (SQLite, HTTP on 127.0.0.1, Server-Sent Events) serving one vanilla HTML/CSS/JS interface, hosted in native windows by a thin **PySide6 / QtWebEngine** shell. Without PySide6 the same app runs in the browser.

Why this shape rather than pure Qt Widgets:
- **One UI for every surface.** The main window and all popouts load the same pages with a `popout=` parameter, so Compact/Standard/Expanded views share components and state instead of being separate implementations.
- **Testable end to end.** The whole interface was exercised headlessly with Playwright. Only window management lives in Qt (`companion/shell/qt_shell.py`, ~600 lines, with no data logic).
- **One source of truth.** Every window reads and writes through the backend and is notified over SSE, so a checkbox ticked in the Storyline popout updates the main Guides page immediately (covered by a UI test).
- **Graceful degradation.** If PySide6 is missing, the launcher says so and opens browser mode. Pin and opacity controls then show as disabled, with the reason.

**Spike results in the build environment.** PyPI, Qt downloads and the user's KDE desktop were not reachable from the build sandbox, so Qt itself could not be run here. The following *was* verified:
- Backend, HTTP security, SSE sync, and every page and popout view, in headless Chrome.
- The no-PySide6 fallback path.
- The Qt shell's wiring (popout single-instance, settings persistence, command dispatch, toast queue and stack limit, tray notification path, quit), against a mocked PySide6.

`./run.sh --spike` is the real feasibility test on the user's machine. It opens a pinned popout, a TEST toast and an OS notification, then writes `spike-report.json` with the platform, flags and window positions it observed.

**KDE Wayland policy.** The *Auto* window backend uses XWayland (`QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb;wayland`) on KDE, because native Wayland compositors decide window position and stacking. On native Wayland, Pin, position restore and window opacity are reported as unavailable instead of being faked. The backend can be changed in Settings › Windows, or with `--wayland` / `--xwayland`.

## 2. Run on CachyOS (Bash)
> **Before each command, close the Companion** (main window → close, or tray → Quit), unless the step says otherwise.

```bash
# 1. Get the code (beside, not inside, your dump folders)
cd ~/Documents/PokeMMO-Companion
git clone -b develop https://github.com/haqzo/PokeMMO-Companion.git app
cd app

# 2a. Native windows — self-contained venv (removable: rm -rf .venv)
./scripts/setup-venv.sh
# 2b. …or use system packages instead of the venv:
#     sudo pacman -S --needed pyside6 qt6-webengine xcb-util-cursor

# 3. Optional: native window feasibility test (writes ~/.local/share/pokemmo-companion/spike-report.json)
./run.sh --spike

# 4. Start the Companion
./run.sh                # native windows; falls back to browser mode if PySide6 is missing
./run.sh --browser      # browser mode
./run.sh --xwayland     # force XWayland (pin/positioning on KDE Wayland)

# 5. Import your private data once (in the app: Settings › Data & privacy), or from the terminal:
./run.sh --import-dumps ~/Documents/PokeMMO-Companion/Pokemmo-Dumps \
         --import-guides ~/Documents/PokeMMO-Companion/Storyline-guides

# 6. Tests (keep the Companion closed or open; tests use their own temporary data)
python3 -m pip install --user pytest   # if pytest is missing (or use the venv: .venv/bin/pip install pytest)
./scripts/test.sh                                                    # without real-dump golden tests
POKEMMO_DUMPS_DIR=~/Documents/PokeMMO-Companion/Pokemmo-Dumps ./scripts/test.sh   # + golden tests
```
User data lives in `~/.local/share/pokemmo-companion/` (SQLite, backups, logs, private imports). Override it with `--data-dir`. Windows: `run.ps1` is provided but **untested**.

| Home | Latest official update with an in-app article reader (grouped changes, "what this changes in the Companion", provenance badge, source link); event details with status (Concluded / Upcoming / window-open-unconfirmed); explicit "No upcoming official events confirmed"; Live summary; configurable Continue shortcuts; manual "Check forum" (official RSS: titles only, honest failure message) | The official forum blocked automated reads during the build, so summaries are labelled *official source · via research* or *· cross-checked* (PikaMMO), never *read directly*. No live refresh of article bodies. |
| Pokédex | 649-card responsive grid; search by name, number, type or ability; generation; type / region / horde / season / egg-group / favourite filters with visible chips and Clear; sort (#, name, BST, favourites); keyboard grid; split detail at wide widths, in-place at narrow; tabs Overview, Locations (season switch; Lure / Special / Unknown never shown as %), Moves (Level / Egg / Tutor / "TM (unconfirmed)" / Other; missing metadata flagged), Evolution, Forms, Breeding, Notes; favourites + notes; silhouette fallback; popout | Without import: names, numbers and types only. All dump fields are labelled DUMP_ONLY (extraction date unknown). Patch overlays: only Lickitung's catch rate (Oct 30). No shiny toggle yet. |
| Tools | Type matchups (17 types, Gen II–V, defensive checker); Natures; Team builder (saved teams, weakness/resist table, STAB coverage); EV & horde planner (dump yields, arithmetic only); Stat calculator (ESTIMATE); Catch estimate (gated behind an "I understand" tick, ESTIMATE, generic model) | **Damage calculator disabled**, with the reason: there are no verified PokeMMO regression cases. |
| Breeding | Parent A \| Offspring \| Parent B preview: egg-group / gender / Ditto / genderless / cannot-breed checks; one item per parent; brace → guaranteed stat and Everstone → nature (official 2015 rule); everything else shown as *possible*, never as a probability; baby/incense cases flagged; consumption warning; no Breed button. Saved pairings. Plan tab: brace tree (e.g. 5×31 = 16 breeders; natured = 32), per-node manual status, item counts, manual prices, export/import, "open this step in Preview". | Live | Reports: opt-in, read-only Alphapedia ntfy adapter (consent dialog, dedupe by message ID, replayed history never alerts, backoff, source health); filters; inspector with times, source and delivery result; **TEST notifications** (toast and/or OS, clearly labelled) and a routing matrix; clear history. Legendaries: documented monthly cycle (Nov = Moltres / Suicune), next month, 12-month calendar, per-run caught toggles. Legendary rollover time is unknown, so there is no countdown. No cave feed exists. |

Outline steps are "outline-unverified". |

Native shell adds Pin, window opacity, lock position, minimise, edge-resize and geometry restore (with an off-screen guard) | Native behaviour is **untested on real KDE/Windows**; see §5. |

## 4. Data provenance decisions to confirm in review
1. **Bundled species index** (`companion/data/species_index.json`) contains only the National number, English name, type(s) and generation for #001–#649. These are common public facts, generated once from your dump and checked for duplicate mono-types and the 17-type set. Nothing else from the dump is in Git. *Please confirm you are happy with this; otherwise I'll make it import-only.*
2. **News/events snapshot:** independently written summaries with the official URL and a provenance level. The Nov 19 changelog details come from the project's Phase 3 research. Nov 5/13 and Oct 30 details were cross-checked against PikaMMO's write-ups of the official posts.
3. **Better Default palette:** sampled from official v1.8.0 screenshots (window #161924, cells #252833, selection near-white, soft stat colours, type tags). It still needs the theme XML or your eye for sign-off.
4. **Walkthroughs and dumps** are imported privately into `~/.local/share/pokemmo-companion/private/` and never committed or uploaded.

## 5. Tests — what was actually run
- `python3 -m pytest tests` → **93 passed, 14 skipped** (no dump). With `POKEMMO_DUMPS_DIR` set to your dumps → **107 passed**. Python 3.13, Ubuntu container, headless Chrome 153.
  - Core: schema/migration/backup, newer-schema refusal, settings validation and legibility clamps, token/Host/traversal security, SSE delivery, Gen II–V chart totals (46 / 57 / 7), textbook stat values.
  - Services: independent runs, undo batches, mark-through preview, mandatory-only counts, soft delete/restore, ODT parsing and change detection, rate strings never coerced, breeding rules and tree shapes, live dedupe / replay / quiet mode / TEST routing, legendary months, cave never "current", event status, PTS separation, backup merge/replace.
  - Golden (your dump): Lickitung 75, Snowscape flagged, Zorua "Unknown rate", Altering Cave = Unown only, Zekrom/Moltres special, Pikachu single type, gendered sprites 521/592/593, Bulbasaur "Lure only", Pikachu Power Plant 20 %, ability slots, real breeding pairs.
  - UI (Playwright): every route renders with zero console errors; nav switch keeps the page; in-app article; Pokédex search / detail / favourite; filters and Clear; two runs independent **across a full backend restart**; TEST toast and history; Storyline popout ↔ main sync; breeding brace preview.
- **Not run here (needs you):** anything Qt-native on KDE X11/Wayland or Windows (pin, toasts, tray, opacity, multi-monitor, DPI, fullscreen PokeMMO), the real ntfy feed, the official RSS check.

## 6. Known limitations / likely first-video findings
- Native shell untested on real hardware: watch for frameless-popout drag/resize quirks, toast placement, tray behaviour on Plasma, and XWayland font blur under fractional scaling.
- Exclusive-fullscreen PokeMMO will cover pinned popouts. Use windowed or borderless.
- Browser mode cannot pin or fade windows (shown as disabled). Popups must be allowed.
- Imported walkthrough steps are long, paragraph-like lines. The Compact Storyline view shows one at a time.
- Damage calculator intentionally unavailable. Catch is an estimate only.

## 7. Suggested walkthrough for the first recorded video (~15 min)
Start with the Companion closed. Run `./run.sh --spike` first if you want the window report on camera, then close it and run `./run.sh`.
1. **Launch and onboarding**: welcome dialog → *Import data now* → Settings › Data: import dumps (show the manifest), then walkthroughs.
2. **Shell**: resize the window; switch Settings › Appearance › Navigation to Horizontal and back (page stays); text size 120 %; Alt+1…5.
3. **Home**: Read details on the Nov 19 changelog → Back; open Halloween 2026 (Concluded); press *Check forum* (shows OK or an honest failure).
4. **Pokédex**: scroll; search "zorua" → Locations (Unknown rate); Bulbasaur → Locations (Lure only); filters Gen V + Water + Horde ×5 → chips → Clear; Pikachu → favourite, note; pop out the detail; narrow the window to show in-place detail.
5. **Tools**: Type matchups (Ghost + Steel check); Natures; Breeding Preview (Raichu ♂ × Pikachu ♀, Power Anklet on B → Speed guaranteed, Pichu baby flag, consumption warning); Plan tab (5×31 + Adamant → 32 breeders, prices, mark a node Done); Egg Moves; Team builder; Damage page shows why it is off; Catch estimate gate.
6. **Live**: Reports (feed off, honest empty state) → *Send TEST notification* (toast + OS) → open it in history; optionally *Connect report feed…* to show the consent dialog; Legendaries (Moltres / Suicune, calendar, caught toggle); Altering Cave (Unknown, log one observation).
7. **Guides**: create "YourName · Main", tick steps in Kanto; create "YourName · Alt" (empty), tick in Unova; switch back (independent); switch the Hoenn source to your walkthrough; Undo; Mark up to current…; open the Storyline popout.
8. **Popouts**: Pin / unpin, mode C/S/E, window opacity, background opacity, lock, minimise main window, click into the game behind the popout, close and reopen (geometry restored).
9. **Settings**: Windows table, close behaviour (Quit vs tray), notification routes and corner, backup export.
10. **Restart**: quit completely (tray → Quit, or close with Quit policy), run `./run.sh` again, and show that runs, checkmarks, favourites, filters, popout preferences and the last page are all restored.
